name: Workshop eval comparison
display_title: Fix admin, quick model and Auto Router settings a customer deployment ran into

head_commit.message:
Pick Auto's allowed models as chips, like the Share dialog's people

The allowed models were one comma-separated text field. They are now
staged as chips in a composer like the Share dialog's: suggested names
are picked from a list, and any other gateway name is typed and added
with Enter or a comma, or as "Add ... exactly". Suggestions are each
routable provider's every model, plus the exact names that are certain:
Workers AI's @cf/ IDs and OpenAI's openai/<id>. Anthropic's gateway names
differ from its model IDs, so only its wildcard is suggested.

The Share dialog's chip pill moves to components/ComposerChip.tsx, which
both use.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
